Specification: Backward-curved centrifugal impeller with 24 V DC EC (brushless, electronically commutated) outer-rotor motor
250 mm diameter, 9 blades with uneven (modulated) spacing and serrated trailing edges, 180 mm inlet, PA66-GF30, balanced G1.0
Horizontal on the fan deck at z = 600-760 mm, sucking up through the filter centre and blowing out to the 360 deg pop-up gap
1,600 rpm limit; Turbo set point 1,200 rpm (a bigger wheel turning slower is much quieter)
Sine-wave (FOC) motor drive inside the fan, so no electrical whine; PWM 25 kHz (above hearing), FG tach 2 pulses/rev, INA226 power monitor
Ball bearings, L10 life >= 40,000 h at 40 deg C (about 9 years at 12 h/day)
4 x M4 on soft silicone isolators (30 Shore A) to a floating fan deck; inlet bell-mouth P20 sealed with PU foam
DebrisGuard 5 + LifeHEPA 60 + OdourCore 50 + outlet/cap 15 = 130 Pa at 750 m3/h
